# extension-polaris.txt: app polaris 子命令
# 对应 extension/polaris_test.go

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app polaris list --app $BKMS_APP_ID
stdout .

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app polaris list --app $BKMS_APP_ID -o json
stdout .

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app polaris list
outcontains 'required'

# create error cases
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app polaris create -f /tmp/nonexistent.yaml
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app polaris create --app $BKMS_APP_ID
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app polaris create --app $BKMS_APP_ID -f /tmp/nonexistent-polaris-spec-xyz.yaml
outcontains 'not found'

# update error cases
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app polaris update --name nonexistent -f /tmp/nonexistent.yaml
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app polaris update --app $BKMS_APP_ID -f /tmp/nonexistent.yaml
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app polaris update --app $BKMS_APP_ID --name nonexistent
outcontains 'required'

# delete error cases
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app polaris delete --name nonexistent
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app polaris delete --app $BKMS_APP_ID
outcontains 'required'

# weight error cases
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app polaris weight --config some-config --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME --weight 100
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app polaris weight --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME --weight 100
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app polaris weight --app $BKMS_APP_ID --config some-config --weight 100
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app polaris weight --app $BKMS_APP_ID --config some-config --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME
outcontains 'required'
